content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital product

A digital product store with no-KYC payments allows creators to sell ebooks, courses, and other digital content without relying on conventional payment processors. This model is crucial in regions where access to platforms like Stripe is restricted, enabling creators to maintain financial independence. By utilizing NOWPayments for payment processing, creators can avoid high fees—unlike platforms like Gumroad that charge 10% per sale, which can significantly diminish earnings. The ability to retain almost all revenue is essential for sustainability and growth.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure consists of a straightforward combination of free and paid tools that work together to create a fully functional digital store. By employing GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, combined with Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, creators can automate the entire sales process. NOWPayments facilitates instant cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring that payments are processed efficiently without the burden of KYC regulations. This architecture grants creators complete control over their data and sales without dependence on any external platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is ideal for digital creators, such as authors, educators, and designers, who need a reliable way to monetize their work without the limitations of conventional payment processors. The architecture is specifically designed for individuals in regions like Pakistan, Kenya, and Ethiopia, where platforms such as PayPal and Stripe may impose restrictions. By offering a method to sell directly to consumers with minimal fees, creators can maximize their earnings and foster a sustainable income stream.
Retain 99.5% of your earnings with NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of this digital store include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for managing backend processes, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing. Additionally, creators can use Supabase or Google Sheets for order management and Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive for file delivery. Together, these elements create a robust ecosystem that ensures smooth transactions, instant product delivery, and complete ownership of the sales process.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own digital product store today, first, choose your hosting solution—either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up your backend with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, integrating NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions. Organize your product information in Supabase or Google Sheets, and use Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive for file delivery. Finally, load your products, configure your store, and you’re ready to start selling without the constraints of traditional platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using a digital product store that accepts cryptocurrency payments through NOWPayments. This allows you to bypass traditional payment processors, significantly reducing costs and maximizing your revenue. This approach is especially beneficial in regions where these platforms are unavailable or heavily restricted, enabling you to retain more profits and maintain full control over your sales.
No KYC means faster, hassle-free transactions.

This kit includes all six blueprints and seven templates necessary to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore these options.
Your Deployment Checklist

Choose your hosting platform: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency. Organize product details in Supabase or Google Sheets. Utilize Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive for file delivery. Load your digital products into the store and configure your settings. Launch your store and start selling to customers around the world.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up a digital product store without KYC?

To set up a digital product store without KYC, use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, and integrate NOWPayments to process cryptocurrency transactions. This allows you to avoid traditional payment processors that require identification, enabling a smoother selling process.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a nominal fee of 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than the 10% fee charged by platforms like Gumroad. This means more revenue stays in your pocket with each sale.
Can I sell digital products like templates without Payhip?

Yes, you can sell digital products such as templates without using Payhip by creating your own store with the tools provided by COREMERCH. This setup allows you to retain full control over your sales and payment processing.
What kind of digital products can I sell?
You can sell a variety of digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. The digital store setup accommodates all these types seamlessly.
Is there ongoing support after deployment?

Yes, when you purchase stacks like the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack, you receive 30 days of support to help you with any questions or issues you may encounter during the initial phase.
